$comment: Frozen accounting and uncertainty rules. See methodology.md sections 9-10.
tierRule: classify each request by its own prompt length; if per-request attribution is unavailable the stage tier is undetermined and its cost is reported as labelled lower/upper bounds or unavailable, never silently at the lower tier
unknownCategory: unknown, never zero; any unknown stage cost makes the workflow and condition totals unavailable
costPerAccepted: sum of estimated cost over all valid scored workflows in the condition / accepted workflows; undefined when accepted == 0

costInterval.zeroSuccessResamples: kept, ordered as +infinity, fraction reported as undefined; an interval bound landing in that mass is reported as unbounded

pooling: none across workflows; no combined pairing score; no significance tests across native tools
